$schema.description: JSON Schema location for editor completion and validation.

dialect.description: Dialect module specifier, resolved relative to this config.

driver.description: Database driver module specifier, resolved relative to this config.

schema.description: SQL file or directory of *.uncut.sql files, relative to this config.

migrations.description: Migration directory, relative to this config. Defaults to ./migrations.

decisions.description: Review decisions file, relative to this config. Defaults to uncutsql.decisions.json.
